data_manifest.funding_endpoint_note: Bitget v2 history-fund-rate returned only the available recent pages; older funding is absent from the public endpoint and is not fabricated.

extensions.funding_endpoint_note: Bitget v2 history-fund-rate returned only the available recent pages; older funding is absent from the public endpoint and is not fabricated.

execution: 5m OHLC execution and mark-price proxy; routine exposure may use maker-touch model; protective exits use taker; deterministic impact/slippage; 2% per-bar participation cap.
funding: Only public Bitget funding records in local cache are applied; earlier missing settlements are not fabricated.
limits: Public funding endpoint does not provide the full 2020-2026 funding history; the backtest uses only the observed 2026-06-27 to 2026-10-06 settlements.
Five-minute OHLC is coarser than tick/order-book replay; maker queue priority is unobserved.
Maintenance-margin brackets and impact are deterministic assumptions; no liquidation occurred in the base runs.
The data were available during research and are not a blind out-of-sample test.
